name: Valsamoggia (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valsamoggia (fleurs-de-lis on blue above a tower and wavy bars) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Valsamoggia, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Valsamoggia arms — fleurs-de-lis on blue above a tower and wavy bars, crowned, within branches
